Faculty of Applied Sciences
The Faculty of Applied Sciences aims to shape tomorrow’s technology leaders in computing science and engineering. Research areas include biomedical engineering, sustainable energy, mechatronics, natural language processing, network systems, computer imaging and medical computing.
Academic Units
School of Computing Science
School of Engineering Science
School of Mechatronic Systems Engineering
School of Sustainable Energy Engineering
Visit the Faculty of Applied Sciences Website
Learn more about their programs and how to apply. Contact graduate program assistants for program and application inquiries.
Visit Faculty Website
Featured Graduate Student
Reza Safavi
Reza is a Sustainable Energy Engineering doctoral student in the Faculty of Applied Sciences focusing on hybrid electric and low-carbon gaseous fuel engines.{Special Graduate Entrance Scholarship}
Kamaria Kuling
Kamaria is building modelling tools to help policy makers effectively and efficiently address climate and other system impacts and trade-offs.
Trevor Barnes
Trevor is a Sustainable Energy Engineering Master's student in the Faculty of Applied Sciences who develops energy models to evaluate system level renewable energy transitions and support effective policy development. (Special Graduate Entrance Scholarship)
Seyed Hesam Mirfarsi
Hesam is a Sustainable Energy Engineering Doctoral student in the Faculty of Applied Sciences whose research focuses on developing environmentally-friendly fuel cell materials.
Md Eliasinul Islam
Eliasinul is a Sustainable Energy Engineering Doctoral student. Three research keywords: modelling, renewable resources, open-source (Pacific Institute of Climate Solutions (PICS) scholarship)
Jake Loftus
Jake is a Sustainable Energy Engineering master student. Three research keywords: Photovoltaics, Sustainability and Hydrogen (BC Graduate Scholarship)
José Ignacio Trujillo Galarza
José is a Sustainable Energy Engineering PhD doctoal student. Three research keywords: Emerging Solar Technologies, Perovskites, Sustainability
Eric Brace
Eric is an Engineering Science Doctoral student in the Faculty of Applied Sciences working with miniature probes that use light, in a way similar to ultrasound, to look at the layers of tissue in the body to identify and treat early cancer. (Graduate Fellowship)
Basil Giannopoulos
Basil is a Engineering Science master student in the Faculty of Applied Sciences. Three research keywords: wearable sensors, stretchable electronics, electronic skin (NSERC-CGSM)
Amirhussein Zia
Amirhussein is a Mechatronic Systems Engineering doctoral student. Three research keywords: Power Electronics, Machine Learning, Energy Systems.
Dominic Jaworski
Dominic is a Mechatronics System Engineering Doctoral student in the Faculty of Applied Sciences whose research focuses on biomedical engineering by measuring sleep quality with non-invasive devices. (Graduate Fellowship)
Marie-Anne Dussault Gomez
Marie-Anne is a Mechatronic Systems Engineering Master's student in the Faculty of Applied Sciences whose research involves using neuroimaging technologies to study how brain activity is disrupted in youth with depression. (CIHR CGS Masters Scholarship, Special Grad Entrance Scholarship)
Pardis Sadeghi
Pardis is a Mechatronic Systems Engineering Master's student in the Faculty of Applied Sciences whose research was to develop a mathematical/numerical model to predict the behaviour of a novel capillary-driven microfluidic flow battery named PowerPAD. (Graduate Fellowship)
Pooya Taheri
Pooya works on improving the functionality and efficiency of electric machines.
Milad Ebadi
Milad is a Mechatronics System of Engineering doctoral student in the Faculty of Applied Sciences researching energy modelling and retrofit modelling of buildings to reduce energy consumption and greenhouse gas emission reduction to fight against climate change and lead our society toward sustainability. (Special Graduate Entrance Scholarship)
Callum Dharam Chhokar
Callum is a Mechatronic Systems Engineering Master's student in the Faculty of Applied Sciences researching and developing a novel pulsating pipe that involves the spread of heat. (NSERC CGS Masters Scholarship)
Catherine Taylor
Catherine is a Biomedical Kinesiology & Physiology doctoral student. Three research keywords: Integrative, Translational, Systems-based.
Teresa Lau
Teresa is a Mechatronic Systems Engineering master student. Three research keywords: Injury Prevention, Biomechatronics, Ergonomics (BC Graduate Scholarship)
Vardhan Paliwal
Vardhan is a Mechatronics Systems Engineering doctoral student. Three research keywords: Computational Neuroscience, Clinical Decision Making, Brain Disorders
Zhiyun (Richard) Peng
Zhiyun is a Computing Science Doctoral student in the Faculty of Applied Sciences studying database and data mining. (GPS Graduate Fellowship)
Weina Jin
Weina is a Computing Science Doctoral student in the Faculty of Applied Sciences developing clinical user-centric explainable AI techniques for medical imaging tasks. (Sulzer Pumps Graduate Scholarship)
Ali Izadi
Ali is a doctoral student in Computing Sciences seeking to improve the accuracy and trustworthiness of machine learning methods for using AI in precision medicine
Amirhossein Daneshpajouh
Amirhossein is a doctoral student in Computing Sciences researching power of computers to help fight diseases more effectively.
Kumar Abhishek
Kumar is a PhD student researching medical image analysis methods for dermatological applications, particularly, skin cancer detection. (Special Graduate Entrance Scholarship)
Sami Ma
Sami is researching is utilizing sonar data and video footage in machine learning tools to count salmon. (BC Graduate Scholarship)
Dingyi Sun
Dingyi's research interests include to path planning, machine learning, and robotic perception. (Special Graduate Entrance Scholarship)
Chirong Zhang
Chirong is a Computing Science Doctoral student in the Faculty of Applied Sciences whose research interest focuses on data pricing. (Graduate Dean Entrance Scholarship)
Seyed Alireza Moazenipourasil
Seyed is a Computing Science doctoral student researching problems related to computer vision and reinforcement learning.
Luna Sang
Luna is a Computing Science Doctoral student. Three research keywords: Autonomous Systems, Safety, Machine Learning
S.Mahdi H.Miangoleh
Miangoleh is a PhD student in computing science and their research involves creating 3D models of real-world environments using multiple cameras.
Sean Paulsen
Sean studies engineering science while competing on SFU's track and field team. He is a recipient of the CGS Master's scholarship. Currently, Sean is developing a wearable circuit that can create powerful pulses of light for diagnostic and therapeutic purposes.
Hamid Jafarabadi Ashtiani
Hamid is a Mechatronic Systems Engineering doctoral student. Three research keywords: Power Electronics, Smart Grids and Artificial Intelligence
Hessameddin Amirhosseini
Hessameddin is a Mechatronics Systems Engineering doctoral student. Research keywords: Digital Twin, Smart Manufacturing, Operator Training
Robyn Ritchie
Robyn is studying Statistics for her Doctorate Degree, focusing her research on the decision-making mind of curlers as they throw their shot in Curling.
Farzad Nadiri
Farzad is a Mechatronic Systems Engineering doctoral student. Three research keywords: Autonomous driving, Humanoid robotics, Perception & control.
Reza Hassani
Reza is a Sustainable Energy Engineering doctoral student. Research keywords: Wheel-Rail Interaction, Friction Identification, Predictive Modeling
Allison Wilson
Allison is a Computing Sciences doctoral student. Three research keywords: Security, Automation, Compliance.
Shannon Joyce
Shannon is an Applied Sciences doctoral student. Three research keywords: Implementation science, Perinatal substance use services, Mixed methods evaluation.
Sadra Bahrami
Sadra is a Mechatronic Systems Engineering master's student. Three research keywords: Inertial Sensors, Engineering Optimization, Computational Mechanics.
Negar Razzaghi
Negar is a Sustainable Energy Engineering doctoral student. Three research keywords: Transportation, Emission, Cold climate.
Alvaro Espinosa
Alvaro is a Mechatronic Systems Engineering doctoral student. Three research keywords: AI-aided design, e-mobility, vehicle crash simulations.
Chloé Monty
Chloé is an Earth Sciences PhD student. Three research keywords: Glaciers, hydrology, climate (BC Graduate Scholarship)
Eva Zhu
Eva is a Computer Engineering masters student. Three research keywords: Photonics, Neural Network, Simulation
Waleed Ahmed
Waleed is a Computing Science Master student. Three research keywords: Reinforcement Learning, Agentic AI, Decision-Making
Thomas Goossen
Thomas is a BPK Master's student. Three research keywords: Postpartum Exercise Physiology
